existing_programs_262.authoritative_rule_set: Foreign Film Production Support is selective support of up to 30% of the accepted amount spent in Turkey. The foreign producer must contract with an eligible Turkish co-producer or service company, which applies; the Turkish applicant must satisfy the official recent-production/service track record. The project must score at least 50/100 on the qualification test, be commercially exhibited abroad, and meet current minimum Turkey expenditure of TRY30 million for a feature, TRY6 million for a documentary, or TRY10 million per series episode. For co-productions, eligible Turkey expenditure is apportioned by the foreign producer's ownership share. Payment is made once after completion on invoices and a sworn CPA report. The support cannot be combined with co-production support.
